caption: The drawing depicts a stylized bird perched atop a decorative floral arrangement. The bird is primarily yellow with a black patch on its wing, a black-tipped tail, and a red area around its eye. Its eye is white with a black pupil, and its beak is black. The bird has three feather-like projections on its head and sits on a tall, vertical stem decorated with alternating black and yellow patterns. To the left of the bird, there is a large, red and yellow flower with elongated leaves, and to the right, there is a red flower with pointed petals and a yellow checkered center. Several other leaves, mainly yellow with black outlines or patterns, extend outward from the base of the central stem. The base of the composition is a shallow, red, semi-circular shape with white accents, and yellow curved lines are drawn beneath it, representing additional stylized ground or grass. The background is plain, beige, or cream-colored. At the bottom, there is printed text: "FROM A SGRAFFITO PLATE 1812" and additional information about the artwork and its context.
title: Plate 14: From Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
